# ☀️ Morning Briefing — Sunday, May 24, 2026

## 🌅 Morning Routine Checklist
- [ ] Wake up
- [ ] Drink water
- [ ] Meditate / breathe (10 min)
- [ ] Morning stretch or movement
- [ ] Breakfast
- [ ] Review this briefing
- [ ] Set 3 intentions for the day

## ✅ Today's Focus
- [ ] **20 minutes at the piano** — no recording, no goal, no audience. Just sit with it. This is the root system.
- [ ] **Draft the €97 Independent Artist Toolkit outline** — list what would actually be in it: contacts, resources, the knowledge people keep asking you for.
- [ ] **One hour of thesis reading** — pick one NIME paper from the gesture-mapping cluster and take notes on how it connects to embodied cognition.

## 💭 Pattern to Watch
Sunday is unstructured time, which is when the pull to convert everything into content gets strongest. Notice if you reach for your phone to document rather than experience. The audit was clear: *designate some making as permanently private.* Today's piano session doesn't need to become a story. Let it be yours.
